chunks: Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Sandal, from Dawud ibn Farqad, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): What is the reward for one who visits Husayn (peace be upon him) every month? He said: 'He has the reward of one hundred thousand martyrs, like the martyrs of Badr.'

key_terms.الْحُسَيْنَ: Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him)
key_terms.بَدْرٍ: Badr (site of the first major battle in Islam)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting Imam Husayn monthly according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores the perpetual spiritual merit of Ziyarat al-Husayn, linking monthly devotion to the high status of Badr martyrs. This comparison elevates the visitor’s reward to that of the elite companions who fought at the first decisive battle of Islam, emphasizing the enduring significance of Husayn’s sacrifice in Shia piety. The monthly frequency suggests a continuous renewal of covenant and love (Mawadda) for the Ahl al-Bayt.
